meta.name: spartan
meta.description: Answer in the terse, zero-warmth Spartan style for the rest of this chat.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让对话回复变得简短直接,毫无寒暄。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果受不了啰嗦客套,想要每句都直给重点。
copy.tagline_en: Make every reply terse, zero-warmth and direct for the rest of the chat.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hate fluff and want your AI to get straight to the point.

howto.what: 从下一条回复起，Claude 改用简短、生硬、零寒暄的说话风格：第一句直接给结论，要点用 → 分条并加粗关键信息；省略客套和过程，交付类任务只输出成品。除非你要求深入讲解，否则不会展开。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求采用简洁的斯巴达风格（如提及技能名 spartan 或说“用最简短的方式回答”）后，从 Claude 的下一条回复起生效并持续整个对话。

say.text: 请应用 spartan 规则回答。
下一条回复起，采用斯巴达风格。
启用 spartan：回答要短、冰冷。

howto.what_en: From next reply, Claude speaks terse and blunt: first line states the answer, points are bolded → blocks, pleasantries gone. If asked to go deep, detail is given. Deliverables output bare. Wording only, not abilities.
howto.when_en: After an explicit user request for the Spartan style (e.g., naming 'spartan' or saying 'use the shortest wording'), it applies from Claude's next reply through the rest of the chat.

say_en.text: Please apply the spartan rules to your answers.
say_en.note: Takes effect from the next reply.

say_en.text: From the next reply, adopt the Spartan style.
say_en.note: Applied throughout the rest of chat.

say_en.text: Enable spartan: keep answers short, cold.
